selector.rationale: The clinical presentation and histopathology images, particularly the band-like vascular proliferation and round vascular spaces lined by a single layer of endothelial cells, are more consistent with PPH. The lack of grenz zone and negative D2-40 staining also support this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Kaposi's sarcoma
rejected.why: The presence of a single layer of endothelial cells and lack of atypia, as well as the negative D2-40 staining, contradict the typical features of Kaposi's sarcoma.
